consumer: The engine dialogue/condition check u_has_items (condition.cpp::set_has_items), which asks yes/no: does the character actor possess count of 1st_aid via has_charges||has_amount.
scope: only the character's own carried items (on-person inventory + wielded + worn), not nearby/reachable items
decisive_source: src/condition.cpp::set_has_items builds a condition lambda returning actor->has_charges(item_id,count)||actor->has_amount(item_id,count) over the alpha/beta character actor — an engine-computed possession predicate.
divergence: A 1st_aid kit lying on the ground at the player's feet (or in an adjacent tile/vehicle cargo) but not in inventory: the on-person predicate returns false, exposing any answer that re-derived 'holding' from reachable/nearby state.
